findings.summary: Tweet author field is quoted but not escaped with _yaml_str, leaving the YAML-injection vector this diff was meant to close.
findings.mechanism: tweet_author comes from the untrusted oEmbed API (data.get("author_name")). Every other interpolated field in this diff (source_url, contributor, title, paper_authors, arxiv_id) is wrapped in _yaml_str before being placed inside double quotes, but this line only adds quotes around the raw value: author: "{tweet_author}". An author name containing a `"` (e.g. `evil", injected: true, x: "`) breaks out of the quoted scalar and injects arbitrary YAML keys into the frontmatter, exactly the attack the change set out to fix.
